name: Beyond the Ruins
source:
Beyond the Ruins is a post apocalyptic furry visual novel focused more on Adventure and Horror. You play as the MC (Roger by default) through his adventures and building relationships to the people along the journey.

The setting takes place in a chamber where you are brought to a Shelter that the people who took you reside in. You woke up from a coma and meet new people who will guide you through your adventure. 

[From [url=https://shibziroo.itch.io/beyond-the-ruins]Itch.io[/url]]
